notes.title: My New Free Game "Desktop Cube-Man" Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am excited to announce that my new game "Desktop Cube-Man" is now officially released and free to play! 

After developing "Escape Expert" a few years ago, "Desktop Cube-Man" is my second game to be published on steam. Everyone is welcome to play. 

It is a free multiplayer PC desktop game, you can simply place on the desktop or enter challenge mode. In challenge mode, you can just idle casually, or try to challenge higher difficulties with friends. You can gain experience through idle time and unlocks more behavior modes.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/791410/_/

notes.title: Updated graphics quality setting, tutorial and resources signal in 5/Apr/2018
notes.notes:
Firstly, I found many players using the "Very Low" graphics quality which is the default graphics quality before, but they don't know it, then many people said the graphics are too bad in some comments. Although I admit my game graphics quality is not good enough compared with some 3A games, that is not good. To avoid these from happening again, so I changed the default graphics quality to "Ultra" and delete others. Acutally, the "Ultra" quality is just the normal default quality for me in developing this game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/e16b8bdfac53e49a60ed6f61d009bd976b7527d2.jpg[/img]

In "Very Low" graphics quality↓↓↓
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/26702e8fe3b1038b8f1cacca96987b7949787ae5.jpg[/img]

In "Ultra" graphics quality (should be default normal graphics quality)↓↓↓
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/360c4373ad687146c272d38b377190c7ba895dff.jpg[/img]
We can see there are many differences between 2 qualities, especially texture, blur and shadow.

Secondly, I found many players lost their way in Tutrials, so I made it easier. For example, player only need to buy food from any shops, when player have to buy food from a specific shop in before. I also changed the signal for every resources point.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/836f3841a2d0fdbe2d5b0f339a89d640c0fdddf1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/a2fb9d43696a7cf40fd2be82fc2aae26569fae09.jpg[/img]

Thirdly, player can now skip the tutorial by clicking a button on the top-right corner of screen. After player falt by losing any money and resources, I add a statistic interface with total survived days and maximum survived days when showing game over.

notes.title: new Multiplayer mode is basically done, new gameplay and features
notes.notes:
the new Multiplayer mode is basically done what I designed before,  I hope people like it. If many people like it, I will continue work on it and make better.

In this Multiplayer mode ,player can act Escape Expert or join the Polices，it support maxmun 20 players.

As Escape Expert , your task is to search and find VIPs and survive until evacuated
 [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/f58fccf325a5cacb20eea70c30e8cb30c2d306a2.png[/img]


In the new version, If you was arrested, your teammates can try to save him from the prison, but it is very danger. If all of you were arrested, your mission will be fail. 

As Police
You need to find and arrest all the Escape Expert before they finished their tasks, but you have to know that polices are the supporting roles in this game, you won't be easy to make it.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/20ef74d4092ad260244c370ade8c900cae994cc2.jpg[/img]

Please try to play it, then welcome to give me feedback, I will keep improving my game.

notes.title: Decreased the purchasing price and improved NPC in updates 2/1/2018
notes.notes:
I played my own game around 100 hours, I found the money cost too fast due to buy food and repair during working in a mission. Sometimes player survive 7 days, but cost all money, then fail.

So decreased the price:
Convenience Store $1000 -> $600
Drivethrough $5000 -> $2000
Fruit stand $1000 -> $200
Market $10000 -> $5000
Small Repair shop $ 10000 -> $ 5000

I also fixed the problems when NPC climbing hills

About the multiplayer, I need much more time to do it, there are much more problems
The map in new mode would like this but not final，5km*5km（map in PUBG is 8km*8km）

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/88f051bdf9fc350af5e3118e9b55fa71585c139b.png[/img]

Some player said the card movement is too unreasonable, actually, I just want to made the movement simple and easy to control before, but seems not satisfy the players' feeling, so I made some changes today.

1. you can't turn around without move forward any more
2. No "reverse is backwards" problem any more, when you go forward, left is turning left, when you go backward, left is turing right.
3. some balance changed
4. add a Level UI, future I will make more uses about it.
5. fixed the NPC position is not touching the ground problem
6. add more tips.

notes.title: Some updates from 18/12/2017 to 20/12/2017
notes.notes:
I never stop working on my game in last week, no time to provide too many news on community for every small update, but you can see I make several updates per day.

1. made a new car available in 4S Store for sale
2. add some fog effect on the scene.
3. add some tips for new player
4. fixed some bug about random get work and buying something.
5. I found many people hit the police car uncarefully in the tutorial, so I make a exception situation when new player doing tutorial.
6. added more NPC car on the scene
7. change the default camera position
8. add some new building on the scene
9. balance some parameters
10. add some new achievements
11. made a potato car DLC for Supporter Edition

(Originally, Someone say he want to pay more to support me. I planed about increase the price, but maybe that is not a good idea for normal player, so I made a supporter DLC, learned from other games)

(If you want to support me to develop this game and pay more for donation, you can buy it, you will get this souvenir car. If you just a normal player want to try this game, you don't need to buy it at all.)

notes.title: Untitled
Big update about AI, update in 15/12/2017
notes.notes:
Today, I optimized the behaviours of AI. I know the AI is really bad before, but now it become better.
1. It will avoid the wall and won't hit the wall when turning a corner. 
2. Police AI will start to arrest you after you do something to him. then you will have to help yourself to escape out of this town as a new work. 
3. Add some new Achievement such as NO ZUO NO DIE.

notes.title: About updates around 13/12/2017, a new function similar with "back mirror"
notes.notes:
I updated several times in these two days, somethings changed:

1. added more police at the begining, police will also spawn every 60 seconds or every 30s when one of them found you. Go to sleep is the only way to reset their amount. You can see more polices, I think it is very exciting,

2. added a new function similar with "back mirror", I don't know how to describe it. there will be a second screen on the top right side when you are being tracked, it will show the police car is behind you. You can close it in the "Option" If you don't like it.

3. changed some setting about buying something, Originally, There is a risk probability, the citizen may identified you and call the police, but you still can buy something successfully. Now If so, you will also have another 50% fail to buy something, and have to run away.

4. Fixed the problem about the bank robbers mission's introduction

5. Add a data about Exp, you can't see it in the game UI, but I already put it in the code and your saved data, I will make it useful in the future.

My next plan is trying to make multiplayer mode.

I also have some players report that the resources are consuming too fast, so I change the balance immediately, but I have to say that this is one of the feastures of this game, it have to be a constraint. Another problem is the Space button has a BUG, I fixed that in a new version now

This game may be a little bit too difficult to new player, but it is fun for me, so I am going to make a difficulty option in the feature

notes.title: About game development progress, release time and the very begining version
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/d35f0f46f22b6dc691d82e4301eae1ab29410efe.png[/img]

[b]When will this game release?[/b]
About my game “Escape Expert”, now the main design contents were done without BUG, it can be played now. In my original plan, I want to release it today (2/12/2017), because I can't wait to  share my game idea.

However, there are still many unperfect things, such as UI tips, new player tutorial, balance and lack ot mission amount. Although it is Early Access version now, players always want to provide negative comments, which I don't want it. So I want to use one more week to improve my game before release it.

I have statistics that there are many people visited my game store page, though the game hasn't released. The more player expect it, the more duty and more pressure I have.

[b]Why develop this game? How it look like at the begining version?[/b]

At the begining, four months age, I was studying in UTS in Australia Sydney. It is my last semester, I was doing game designing and programing. Making a 3D game with some topic is my assignment. I chose touch screen and mobile platform as my topic, then made this game's begining version as my assignment. After that, I have more ideas about this game, and I am interested to continue to develop it individually. 
the image below is the very begining version in developing look like
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/6201c1efb646b28ceb8fdfa976942deed08cf01a.jpg[/img]

I found that, mobile phone is no longer enough to support this 3D game, so I develop it only for PC now. After that, I found that if I have no any income, I can't make it in long-term development, even though I really like it, so I chose Steam to publish my game. After that again, I found two friends for help in part-time, one of them can make models for me. We all are unprofessional, no any income now, but we are very enjoying to develop this game. 

Now the game is like the following screenshot
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/d35f0f46f22b6dc691d82e4301eae1ab29410efe.png[/img]

notes.title: The Store Page is available now, there is a story here
notes.notes:
This game ID is 727180 name is 大逃亡专家/Escape Expert
The Store Page is now available: http://store.steampowered.com/app/727180/Escape_Expert/

There is a story:
This game past the review and I already clicked the prerelease button two days ago(18-11-2017), There is an error when I tried to release my game store page, after I refreshed, I can't click the release button again because it disappeared and show me that my store page is on Steam already("Your Store Presence Your game is currently visible on the Steam Store as an upcoming title. You can view your page here"). 

However until just now today(21-11-2017,(UTC +08:00)12pm), I still can 't find my store page, even inter a URL rather than searching on Steam, but I can see my community page. 

I waited 3 days, no one care my problem, but I check every button any possible way to fix it. 

Finally, I tried to change the public plan data, it show me error and can't be saved ,then I tried to open my store page, it work.
